whyCareReason: Erling Haaland scores in his sixth straight Premier League match as Manchester City edge Newcastle 2-1 to reach 18 points atop the table.
teaser: FINAL: Manchester City 2, Newcastle United 1. Haaland 31', Bernardo Silva 68'; Isak 52'. City remain flawless on 18 points.
story:
Why this one matters: Premier League Matchweek 6 concluded Saturday night with Manchester City extending their unblemished run to six victories from six matches.

At the Etihad Stadium, Erling Haaland broke the deadlock in the 31st minute, latching onto a Kevin De Bruyne through ball to score his ninth league goal of the campaign. Alexander Isak equalized for Newcastle early in the second half with a composed low finish, testing Pep Guardiola's defense.

City responded with characteristic authority. In the 68th minute, Bernardo Silva curled an exquisite 20-yard effort into the top corner, securing all three points. City stand alone at the summit with 18 points, three clear of second-placed Arsenal.
stakes: City move to 18 points from six matches, three points clear of Arsenal at the summit.
rivalryAngle: Guardiola's relentless machine overcomes Newcastle's spirited second-half push.
